lessons.trigger_condition: V410 connected freshness-gated verified market context to the adaptive UI policy, but each cycle still treated the current game/region focus independently. A short-lived but valid attention shift could therefore influence automatic market module ordering before the same focus was confirmed again.
lessons.prevention_rule: Persist only compact verified market-context summaries in existing bounded history; require at least two matching confirmations within the last five history rows and confidence >=0.45 before a game or region becomes stable automatic focus; cap any stable-focus experience bonus at +0.03; keep user session overrides immediate; preserve the 17→12→18 screen-neural input shape and all Champion/Challenger, drift, rollback and fail-closed gates.
validation_required: first-seen market game or region focus remains ALL for automatic stable focus
two matching verified confirmations can activate only allowlisted Pokémon/ONE PIECE/NARUTO and KR/JP/US stable focus
a changed one-cycle focus returns to ALL until reconfirmed
stable market-focus experience bonus is capped at +0.03
market context history stores no click pointer browsing or free-form user behavior
user session market-lens override remains immediate and reversible
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs, 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
market and price direction remain uninferred
runtime source generation arbitrary commands Git/main writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V411 adds hysteresis to verified non-directional market context and market-sensitive presentation ordering only. It does not predict price direction, invent facts, expand execution authority, track user behavior, alter the 17→12→18 model shape, auto-rewrite source, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main, or bypass verification.
